identity: Slovakian Rhapsody for alto saxophone and orchestra, piano reduction
findings: Zen-On's composer biography verifies a 2005 Nobuya Sugawa commission and premiere with the Slovak Philharmonic at Suntory Hall, Tokyo.
Piano reduction edition ZN560023 / ISBN 9784115600232 has 44 total pages and belongs to Sugawa's Saxy Ever Originals collection; CiNii identifies 2012 publication.
Publisher verifies a Sugawa recording with Seikyo Kim and Tokyo Symphony Orchestra. CDJapan identifies Aria AVCL-84046, track 9.
Tokyo Kosei Wind Orchestra's official program documents the 2005/2015 wind-orchestra version with Sugawa in April 2015.

arranger-edition: Piano reduction of alto saxophone and orchestra version, ZN560023
